main_text.l: Ludovici Nepos, Pragmatica Sanctionis acerrimus defensor.

semper sibi vendicasse, Galliæ Regis Orator {k} in Concil.

Primò, legem à Ludovico IX. contra Pontifices latam,
qui potestate suâ abutentes, auare in Ecclesia grassarentur,
posteà peruincente Pontificum seu astu, seu potentiâ, ea-
dem, quæ priùs, mala inualuisse; quæ tamen postmo-

page.notes: Running head: the printed "Cap.5." at the top right is not part of the running title and is left out. Page number 226 is printed at the top left. The margin note "g Orat.ibid." is printed beside the line "Caroli Regis", but the text mark I read before "Pontifex" may belong to it or to another mark; the pairing of {g} is uncertain. A stray short mark in the left margin, below the notes, is not printed text and is left out. Italic marking of proper names and Latin phrases in the text is read from the scan and may be slightly off at the edges of italic runs. "vosscitis" is read as printed.
